title: Finite-free scalar projection data for strict etale systems
statement: For the finite-field datum, finite p-adic fields, compactification, source compact-support system and source exceptional adjoint in the scalar-extension setting, there exist the target compact-support system and exceptional adjoint, exact coefficient transports at X, Y and Z, and a compact-support transport projection whose finite-level adjunction mates are isomorphisms.

source.place: Construction 5.15 and Proposition 2.29(2); geometric scalar-extension projection before exceptional transposition.

proof.text: Construct the finite-free scalar extension compact-support system and its exceptional adjoint, then construct the three coefficient transports and the transport projection. The finite-level mates of the projection are isomorphisms by the finite coefficient comparison and the strict etale stage projection; the remaining categorical assembly is performed by the proved exceptionalTransportOfProjection theorem in the parent module.

lean.statement: theorem strictEtaleScalarTransportProjection (D : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ D.p) (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (c : Compactification f) (F : Type (u + 1)) [Field F] [Algebra (Padic l) F] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) F] (i : E →ₐ[Padic l] F) (SA : StrictEtaleCompactSupport (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E) c) (GA : StrictEtaleExceptionalAdjoint _ _ c SA) : let a := strictEtaleSameIndexChange (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E) (strictEtaleIntegerMap l i) ∃ (SB : StrictEtaleCompactSupport (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F) (strictEtaleIntegerMap l i (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E)) c) (GB : StrictEtaleExceptionalAdjoint _ _ c SB) (TX : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport a X SA.PX SB.PX) (TY : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport a Y SA.PY SB.PY) (TZ : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport a c.Z SA.PZ SB.PZ), ∃ P : StrictEtaleTransportProjection a c SA SB TX TY TZ, ∀ n, IsIso (mateEquiv (GA.levelAdjunction n) (GB.levelAdjunction n) (.mk _ _ _ _ (P.level n).inv)).natTrans
